name: reupmatic
description: Reupmatic desktop video processing and automation — integration build

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && vite build
scripts.test:core: npm run build:core && node --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/render-tracker.test.mjs tests/media-response.test.mjs tests/render-coordinator.test.mjs tests/project.test.mjs tests/batch.test.mjs tests/folder.test.mjs tests/design-skill.test.mjs tests/vision.test.mjs tests/library.test.mjs tests/settings.test.mjs tests/export-file.test.mjs tests/processing.test.mjs tests/processing-persistence.test.mjs tests/render-artifact.test.mjs tests/catalog.test.mjs tests/distribution.test.mjs tests/profiles.test.mjs tests/workflows.test.mjs tests/post-schedule.test.mjs tests/current-schema.test.mjs tests/editing.test.mjs tests/recovery.test.mjs tests/text-rules.test.mjs tests/editor-history.test.mjs tests/ocr-extraction.test.mjs tests/library-assets.test.mjs tests/subtitle-style.test.mjs tests/soundtrack.test.mjs tests/composition.test.mjs tests/text-layers.test.mjs tests/speech.test.mjs tests/translation.test.mjs tests/synthesis.test.mjs tests/synthesis-artifacts.test.mjs
scripts.test:bridge: npm run build:core && node --test tests/bridge.test.mjs tests/coordinator-native.test.mjs tests/batch-native.test.mjs tests/folder-native.test.mjs tests/library-native.test.mjs tests/models-native.test.mjs tests/workflow-native.test.mjs tests/batch-cli-native.test.mjs tests/synthesis-native.test.mjs
scripts.test:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v
scripts.test: npm run structure:check && npm run scope:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run test:structure && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:ui-library && npm run test:tooling && npm run test:core && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:python
scripts.check:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check worker tests scripts && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check worker tests scripts
scripts.format:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check --fix worker tests scripts && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format worker tests scripts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/editor.e2e.mjs tests/e2e/batch.e2e.mjs tests/e2e/folder.e2e.mjs
scripts.package:source: npm run structure:check && npm run scope:check && npm run contracts:check && node scripts/python.mjs scripts/package_source.py
scripts.test:packaging: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_packaging.py -v
